Join the CanvaUSA Affiliate Program!

Are you ready to unleash creativity and make a difference? Partner with CanvaUSA and earn a fantastic 30% commission on all sales made through your unique discount code!

Why CanvaUSA? ✨ Eco-Friendly & Locally Sourced: Our handcrafted purses are made with sustainable materials. ✨ Unique Customization: Give your audience the chance to design their own style. ✨ Top-Notch Quality: Meticulously crafted for durability and everyday adventures. ✨ Charity Support: Every purchase supports a different charity, making a fashion statement that goes beyond style.

Affiliate Benefits: 🌟 High Commission Rate: Earn 30% on all sales through your code. 🌟 Exclusive Offers: Get access to special discounts and promotions. 🌟 Marketing Support: Receive high-quality marketing materials to help you succeed. 🌟 Community Impact: Join a brand dedicated to sustainability and giving back.

Ready to Make a Difference? Sign up now and start earning while promoting a brand that values creativity, quality, and social impact!


At CANVA USA, we unleash your creativity one handcrafted bag at a time. Join the purse revolution with our eco-friendly, locally sourced purses. Design your own style on our durable and sustainable bags—your ideas, your masterpiece! Our meticulously crafted purses ensure top-notch quality for your everyday adventures. Plus, with each purchase, we support a different charity, making your fashion statement go beyond just style. Join us in crafting a better world, one purse at a time!

We take pride in our commitment to quality. Each and every one of our purses is meticulously crafted and tested to ensure maximum usability and durability. Our items are zip tested, guaranteeing that your belongings are secured and safe. We believe that a well-made purse should not only be a fashion statement but also a trusted companion for your everyday adventures. 

As a brand that caters to YOU, we understand that you value individuality, sustainability, and giving back. We are here to deliver all of that and more. Our purses encompass your desire for self-expression, with each one telling a story that is uniquely yours. By choosing to support a small, local business like ours, you are making a conscious decision to shop ethically and sustainably.
